description: One M3 x 5.7 heat-set insert, Insert only, on the origin, with its thread modeled. The picture in the insert plugin's README is rendered from this design. Each step is one command; `caption` is the text a recording shows for it. A plugin step is a `plugin.run` whose `path` is relative to the repository and whose `approval` is the placeholder `@approval`: tests/examples_test.py fills both in, because the approval changes with every build of the plugin. `expect` is what that test measures: the box and volume of every body, as the build measured them.

steps.caption: An M3 x 5.7 heat-set insert, on its own
